description: This Kotlin source file defines the `TokenRefresher` class, which manages refresh-token logic in a coroutine-safe manner for Android applications. It interacts with storage and API services to refresh session tokens, ensuring thread safety and proper synchronization on refresh operations.

classes.name: TokenRefresher
classes.description: Manages the refresh-token flow in a thread-safe manner using coroutines and mutex locking. It provides a method to refresh tokens blocking calls that coordinate with storage and API services.

methods.name: refreshBlocking
methods.description: Performs a thread-safe refresh of session tokens by interacting with the token store and refresh API, returning the new tokens or null if refresh fails.
